hook: Teaching small shopping agents with real purchase data.

beats.say: Criteo AI Lab released RecoATLAS: an open environment, a paper, and a RecSys 2026 tutorial, after six months of work.
It turns logged bandit feedback from real purchases into tasks for training recommendation agents with reinforcement learning.
The release covers the design, benchmarks, and their results training small, specialized orchestrators to coordinate recommendations. The environment code is open, so others can train their own.
